newsitem.title: USA: NaPro BioTherapeutics adopts rights plan.
newsitem.headline: NaPro BioTherapeutics adopts rights plan.

text.p: NaPro BioTherapeutics Inc said Friday it has approved a stockholder rights plan and set a dividend distribution of one right to purchase 1/100th of a share of a new series of junior participating preferred stock for each share of NaPro common stock held.
The rights plan would be triggered if an individual or group acquired 20 percent or more of the company's common stock.
The company said the plan was not adopted in response to any hostile takeover proposal or any other recent events.
The distribution is to be paid out November 26 to shareholders of record at that date.

If the right becomes exercisable, each holder would be entitled to purchase at the right's then-current exercise price a number of shares of common stock that would have twice the market value. The current price is set at $60, the company said.
